-- Migration 1 of the Hune schema.
CREATE TABLE hune_schema (
    id         boolean     PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT true CHECK (id),
    version    integer     NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 1),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE hune_folders (
    id         text        PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,39}$'),
    title      text        NOT NULL CHECK (char_length(title) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE hune_dashboards (
    uid            text        PRIMARY KEY CHECK (uid ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,39}$'),
    folder_id      text        NOT NULL REFERENCES hune_folders (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    version        bigint      NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 1),
    etag           text        NOT NULL CHECK (etag ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    format_version integer     NOT NULL,
    title          text        NOT NULL,
    document       text        NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(document) <= 4194304),
    updated_at     timestamptz NOT NULL,
    updated_by     text        NOT NULL CHECK (char_length(updated_by) BETWEEN 1 AND 256)
);

CREATE TABLE hune_versions (
    uid        text        NOT NULL CHECK (uid ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,39}$'),
    version    bigint      NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 1),
    kind       text        NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('create', 'save', 'restore', 'move',
                                                    'delete', 'import', 'external', 'migrate')),
    folder_id  text        NOT NULL CHECK (folder_id ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,39}$'),
    document   text        CHECK (octet_length(document) <= 4194304),
    etag       text        CHECK (etag ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    saved_at   timestamptz NOT NULL,
    saved_by   text        NOT NULL CHECK (char_length(saved_by) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
    message    text        NOT NULL CHECK (char_length(message) <= 500),
    save_id    uuid,
    PRIMARY KEY (uid, version),
    UNIQUE (uid, save_id),
    CHECK ((kind IN ('delete', 'external')) OR document IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK (kind <> 'delete' OR document IS NULL),
    CHECK ((kind = 'delete') = (etag IS NULL))
);

INSERT INTO hune_schema (id, version, updated_at) VALUES (true, 1, now());

-- The default privileges of 5.25 give the application role INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE on
-- each new table. Only migrate-store writes hune_schema, so remove these rights from each
-- role other than the owner. With the role names of 5.25, this is:
-- REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON hune_schema FROM hune_app;
DO $$
DECLARE r record;
BEGIN
    FOR r IN SELECT DISTINCT grantee FROM information_schema.role_table_grants
              WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'hune_schema'
                AND privilege_type IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE')
                AND grantee <> current_user AND grantee <> 'PUBLIC'
    LOOP
        EXECUTE format('REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON hune_schema FROM %I', r.grantee);
    END LOOP;
END $$;

-- Synthetic table of the expansion vectors and the parity capture (16.13). All data is fictitious.
-- The compose project runs this file at the first start of ClickHouse (docker-entrypoint-initdb.d).
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS analytics.events
(
    `timestamp` DateTime64(3, 'UTC'),
    -- event.* : kind and result of the event.
    `event` Tuple(
        name LowCardinality(String),
        outcome LowCardinality(Nullable(String)),
        reason LowCardinality(Nullable(String))),
    -- system.* : server that wrote the event.
    `system` Tuple(
        region LowCardinality(String),
        server LowCardinality(String),
        version LowCardinality(String)),
    -- metrics.* : size and duration of the work of the event.
    `metrics` Tuple(
        bytes Nullable(UInt64),
        duration_us Nullable(UInt64)),
    -- attributes : free fields of the event (Dynamic sub-paths).
    `attributes` JSON
)
ENGINE = MergeTree
PARTITION BY toYYYYMMDD(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp;

-- for these five names. Run by roles.sql after \connect, in each database except probe_public.

FROM pg_proc p

-- Synthetic setup of the test PostgreSQL of the `pgsource` job (16.9a). -- All data is synthetic. No name here is a real name. -- -- Use. Run this file with psql as a superuser on a new cluster. The script `apply.sh` does it at the first -- start of the container. The file holds no password: each password is a psql variable. -- psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v ro_password=... -v rw_password=... -v bad_password=... -v legacy_password=... -f init.sql -- The file is not idempotent: run it one time on an empty cluster. -- -- Roles (the names are a contract with the tests): -- metrics_owner owner of the database, the schemas and the tables. No login. -- metrics_writer a plain role with INSERT on metrics.write_target. No login. Only hune_bad_noinh is a member. -- hune_ro the role of 8a.13, as written there. It is the role of the source. -- hune_bad_* deviant roles. Each one has the rights of hune_ro and one more thing that breaks one -- check of the probe (8a.12): -- hune_bad_createrole R1 the attribute CREATEROLE -- hune_bad_pgread R2 member of pg_read_all_data -- hune_bad_create R3 CREATE on the schema metrics -- hune_bad_write R4 INSERT on the table metrics.write_target -- hune_bad_seq R5 UPDATE on the sequence metrics.audit_seq -- hune_bad_col R6 INSERT on one column of metrics.col_target -- hune_bad_dblink R7 EXECUTE on the functions of dblink -- hune_bad_fdw R8 USAGE on the foreign server hune_fx -- hune_bad_signal R7 EXECUTE on pg_terminate_backend and pg_cancel_backend (H1) -- hune_bad_emit R7 EXECUTE on pg_logical_emit_message (H1) -- hune_bad_ts R7 EXECUTE on ts_stat and ts_rewrite (H1) -- hune_bad_noinh R4 a NOINHERIT member of the plain role metrics_writer (M3) -- hune_bad_owner R9 owner of the table metrics.owned, with its own rights -- revoked except SELECT (M3) -- PS11 needs the six roles R1, R2, R3, R4, R7 and R8. The others are extra. -- hune_rw all rights on the schema metrics, for PS07. No superuser. -- hune_md5 the contract of hune_ro, but its password is an MD5 password and pg_hba.conf asks -- the method md5 (PS12). apply.sh writes the pg_hba.conf lines. -- hune_clear the same, with the method `password` (clear text on the wire) (PS12). -- -- Objects of the database `analytics`, schema `metrics`: -- node_load 3 hosts, one row each minute, 720 minutes from 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z (PS01, PS02). -- node_load_v a view of node_load. -- types_all one column of each type of 7.16a, 4 rows (PS06). types_unsupported: other types. -- big_rows 1,000,000 rows (PS04). big_value: one row with a text of 50,000,000 bytes (PS04). -- write_target, col_target, audit_seq objects for the write cases (PS07, PS08). -- The schema `restricted` has one table that no test role can read. The schema `ext` holds dblink. \set ON_ERROR_STOP on -- The four passwords are mandatory. \if :{?ro_password} \else DO $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'psql variable ro_password is not set'; END $$; \endif \if :{?rw_password} \else DO $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'psql variable rw_password is not set'; END $$; \endif \if :{?bad_password} \else DO $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'psql variable bad_password is not set'; END $$; \endif \if :{?legacy_password} \else DO $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'psql variable legacy_password is not set'; END $$; \endif -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Roles of the cluster -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- CREATE ROLE metrics_owner NOLOGIN; -- The role of the source: the SQL of 8a.13, with the password from the variable. CREATE ROLE hune_ro LOGIN PASSWORD :'ro_password' NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS CONNECTION LIMIT 18; ALTER ROLE hune_ro SET default_transaction_read_only = on; ALTER ROLE hune_ro SET statement_timeout = '60s'; ALTER ROLE hune_ro SET idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = '15s'; ALTER ROLE hune_ro SET temp_file_limit = '1GB'; ALTER ROLE hune_ro SET jit = off; -- The deviant roles. The attribute of R1 is set at the creation. The other changes come with the grants below. CREATE ROLE hune_bad_createrole LOGIN PASSWORD :'bad_password' NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB CREATEROLE NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS CONNECTION LIMIT 18; SELECT format( 'CREATE ROLE %I LOGIN PASSWORD %L NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS CONNECTION LIMIT 18', r, :'bad_password') FROM unnest(ARRAY['hune_bad_pgread', 'hune_bad_create', 'hune_bad_write', 'hune_bad_seq', 'hune_bad_col', 'hune_bad_dblink', 'hune_bad_fdw', 'hune_bad_signal', 'hune_bad_emit', 'hune_bad_ts', 'hune_bad_owner']) AS r \gexec -- M3: a role with the attribute NOINHERIT does not use the rights of its groups, but it can run SET ROLE to -- them. The group is a plain role: no attribute, no name pg_*, so R2 does not refuse the membership. CREATE ROLE metrics_writer NOLOGIN; CREATE ROLE hune_bad_noinh LOGIN PASSWORD :'bad_password' NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS NOINHERIT CONNECTION LIMIT 18; GRANT metrics_writer TO hune_bad_noinh; ALTER ROLE hune_bad_noinh SET default_transaction_read_only = on; ALTER ROLE hune_bad_noinh SET statement_timeout = '60s'; -- The role with all rights. CREATE ROLE hune_rw LOGIN PASSWORD :'rw_password' NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS; -- The roles with an old method of login. The MD5 hash needs password_encryption = 'md5' for one statement. SET password_encryption = 'md5'; CREATE ROLE hune_md5 LOGIN PASSWORD :'legacy_password' NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS CONNECTION LIMIT 18; RESET password_encryption; CREATE ROLE hune_clear LOGIN PASSWORD :'legacy_password' NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS CONNECTION LIMIT 18; -- Each role with the contract of hune_ro has the same session defaults as hune_ro. SELECT format('ALTER ROLE %I SET default_transaction_read_only = on', r) FROM unnest(ARRAY[ 'hune_bad_createrole', 'hune_bad_pgread', 'hune_bad_create', 'hune_bad_write', 'hune_bad_seq', 'hune_bad_col', 'hune_bad_dblink', 'hune_bad_fdw', 'hune_bad_signal', 'hune_bad_emit', 'hune_bad_ts', 'hune_bad_owner', 'hune_md5', 'hune_clear']) AS r \gexec SELECT format('ALTER ROLE %I SET statement_timeout = ''60s''', r) FROM unnest(ARRAY[ 'hune_bad_createrole', 'hune_bad_pgread', 'hune_bad_create', 'hune_bad_write', 'hune_bad_seq', 'hune_bad_col', 'hune_bad_dblink', 'hune_bad_fdw', 'hune_bad_signal', 'hune_bad_emit', 'hune_bad_ts', 'hune_bad_owner', 'hune_md5', 'hune_clear']) AS r \gexec GRANT pg_read_all_data TO hune_bad_pgread; -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- The database -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE analytics OWNER metrics_owner' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'analytics') \gexec \connect analytics -- The language of A1: the last line of 8a.13. REVOKE USAGE ON LANGUAGE plpgsql FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE CREATE ON SCHEMA public FROM PUBLIC; -- The five functions that PUBLIC runs by default and that the probe refuses (R7, finding H1): the statement of -- 8a.13, limited to these names. The probe refuses a role that can run pg_logical_emit_message, -- pg_terminate_backend, pg_cancel_backend, ts_stat and ts_rewrite, so hune_ro needs this revoke. The deviant -- roles get their right back below. The fixture does NOT revoke pg_sleep and the other functions of the advice -- A3: the tests of the deadline and of the cancel request use pg_sleep. SELECT format('REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION %s FROM PUBLIC', p.oid::regprocedure) FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace = 'pg_catalog'::regnamespace AND p.proname IN ('pg_logical_emit_message', 'pg_terminate_backend', 'pg_cancel_backend', 'ts_stat', 'ts_rewrite') \gexec CREATE SCHEMA metrics AUTHORIZATION metrics_owner; CREATE SCHEMA restricted AUTHORIZATION metrics_owner; -- dblink lives in its own schema. Its functions go to PUBLIC by default: take that right away, so that -- only hune_bad_dblink can call them (R7). CREATE SCHEMA ext; CREATE EXTENSION dblink SCHEMA ext; SELECT format('REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION %s FROM PUBLIC', p.oid::regprocedure) FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace = 'ext'::regnamespace AND p.proname LIKE 'dblink%' \gexec GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA ext TO hune_bad_dblink; SELECT format('GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION %s TO hune_bad_dblink', p.oid::regprocedure) FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace = 'ext'::regnamespace AND p.proname LIKE 'dblink%' \gexec -- The foreign server of R8. No connection is made to it. CREATE SERVER hune_fx FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER dblink_fdw OPTIONS (host '127.0.0.1', dbname 'analytics'); GRANT USAGE ON FOREIGN SERVER hune_fx TO hune_bad_fdw; -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- The objects of the owner -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- SET ROLE metrics_owner; SET search_path = metrics, pg_catalog; CREATE TYPE level AS ENUM ('debug', 'info', 'warn', 'error'); CREATE DOMAIN positive_int AS int4 CHECK (VALUE > 0); CREATE DOMAIN short_code AS text CHECK (length(VALUE) <= 8); CREATE TYPE pair AS (a int4, b text); -- PS01, PS02: the seed table. The times are known: 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z plus i minutes. CREATE TABLE node_load ( created_at timestamptz NOT NULL, created_plain timestamp NOT NULL, epoch_s bigint NOT NULL, epoch_ns bigint NOT NULL, host text NOT NULL, env text NOT NULL, load float8 NOT NULL ); INSERT INTO node_load SELECT t, t AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', extract(epoch FROM t)::bigint, extract(epoch FROM t)::bigint * 1000000000, h.host, h.env, (i % 60) + h.base FROM generate_series(0, 719) AS i CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT timestamptz '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' + i * interval '1 minute' AS t) AS tt CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('node-a', 'prod', 0.0), ('node-b', 'prod', 100.0), ('node-c', 'stage', 200.0)) AS h(host, env, base); CREATE INDEX node_load_created_at ON node_load (created_at); CREATE VIEW node_load_v AS SELECT created_at, host, env, load FROM node_load; -- PS06: one column of each supported type. The rows: -- 1 typical values; 2 maximum values and NaN; 3 minimum values and the infinities; 4 a NULL row -- with +Infinity in the float columns.
